description:
Read a resource file (a mesh's bounds and surfaces, a scene's nodes, any resource's non-default properties) or a resource a node holds (nodePath and property). Next: summer_set_resource_property.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/inspect-resource"}

maxCharacters.description: Most characters of text to return (default 4000). A longer result is cut and says so.

nodePath.description: With property: a node of the ACTIVE scene tab whose resource to read, e.g. 'Floor'. Do not combine with path.

path.description: A resource FILE: 'res://materials/ground.tres', a mesh 'res://kit/meshes/wall_01.res', a texture, a shape, or a scene/model 'res://models/player.glb'. Loaded read-only in the editor.

property.description: With nodePath: the node property holding the resource, e.g. 'mesh', 'material_override', 'shape', 'environment'.

name: summer_inspect_resource
title: Read a resource
